status: existing-source barrier candidate needs public corrections; owner unaccepted

findings.problem: size > DEFAULT_SCAN_LIMIT rejects valid retained sources allowed by the configured maxBatchBytes/maxScanBytes. DEFAULT_SCAN_LIMIT is the unrelated fixed JSON artifact source envelope.
findings.requiredEffect: Preserve the already verified configured source capacity; validate exact safe bounded descriptor size against its verified expected bytes before allocation/read, without applying an artifact envelope to the retained physical file. Host bytes remain bounded by host admission. Actual size disagreement remains refusal.

findings.problem: checkFileName checks identity/type only. Source size changes after the bounded read are not detected by checks around fsync or acknowledgment.
findings.requiredEffect: For byte-bearing descriptions verify both current named and held-descriptor sizes against the expected length at every binding recheck, including before/after file sync and final acknowledgment. Stable lock descriptions may lack semantic bytes and must not invent a size constraint.

findings.location: directory fsync traversal and final acknowledgment
findings.problem: After a child directory is fsynced, a later ancestor sync can coincide with replacement of that child. Final file checks use /proc/self/fd of the old parent and therefore do not verify that its current absolute name still reaches that parent. No final pass checks all selected directory bindings after all directory syncs.
findings.requiredEffect: Revalidate every retained directory name against its held descriptor after the synchronization pass and before success, as well as relevant parent bindings at file access/checks. Preserve all selected alias names, single physical sync and caller root assertions.

findings.problem: The separate failed flag retains a primary value through cleanup, but the final sourceIo(primary) remaps a non-branded assertion failure, including undefined, to a new diagnostic. This does not preserve the primary thrown value required by the barrier contract.
findings.requiredEffect: Translate filesystem failures at their I/O boundary while retaining an assertion-supplied primary thrown value exactly through cleanup, including undefined. A lone cleanup failure is still translated; caller-owned descriptors remain open. Do not turn genuine I/O failures into raw leaked errors.

findings.location: requireDurableInScope source guard and synchronization ownership bookkeeping
findings.problem: sourceIdentity(source.identity, source.identity) is tautological and can throw on missing identity; the branch !owned && description.fd === undefined is unreachable.
findings.requiredEffect: Remove the ineffective checks/branch and redundant fields or replace the identity guard with meaningful private record validation. Preserve actual named/descriptor identity verification and precise descriptor ownership.
